subject.title: fix(backup): sweep stale temp artifacts before creating new backup

question: Should backup startup be allowed to delete one-hour-old OpenClaw-owned staging dirs and output-adjacent temp archives, and should this PR broaden matching to timestamped default/directory outputs before merge?
rationale: The fix is a destructive startup cleanup policy with compatibility and availability tradeoffs that green CI cannot settle, and the submitted implementation still misses a documented user path.

options.title: Repair And Accept Guarded Cleanup
options.body: Require the timestamped-output repair, rebase/conflict resolution, and real behavior proof before maintainers accept the cleanup policy.

options.title: Accept Fixed-Basename Only
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally land only stable file-output cleanup and leave default/directory timestamped archive temps to a follow-up.

options.title: Pause Cleanup Policy
options.body: Pause or close if startup deletion of stale backup artifacts needs a different recovery, debugging, or operator policy.

recommendation.title: Repair And Accept Guarded Cleanup
recommendation.body: Require the timestamped-output repair, rebase/conflict resolution, and real behavior proof before maintainers accept the cleanup policy.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to both original backup PR merge context and the extraction of backup creation into the current infra owner surface.
